say:2:1710659001:1.source_cn: 殿下！卫兵康特，向您报道！

say:3:1710659002:1.text: At ease. That spider struck without warning. None of the guards were seriously hurt, I hope?
say:3:1710659002:1.source_cn: 不必拘礼。刚才巨蛛突然冲撞过来，守备军们没有受伤吧？

say:4:1710659003:1.text: Just a few scrapes and bruises, Your Highness. They're already patched up.
say:4:1710659003:1.source_cn: 回殿下，有几位同僚受了轻伤，但已得到初步救治，并无大碍。

say:5:1710659004:1.text: Thanks to Captain Gwyneth's decisive shot. Straight to the creature's weak spot!
say:5:1710659004:1.source_cn: 多亏格温妮丝队长出手果决，一箭便击中了巨蛛要害！

say:6:1710659005:1.text: By the time we knew what was happening, the thing was already on the ground. All that remained was cleaning up the mess.
say:6:1710659005:1.source_cn: 待我们反应过来时，巨蛛已经倒下了，就只剩下收拾残局的工作了。

say:7:1710659006:1.text: Her archery continues to set the standard for the Royal Guard. She'll be commended for her actions today.
say:7:1710659006:1.source_cn: 嗯，她的箭术不愧是守备军的典范。对于她此次英勇的表现，...

say:8:1710659007:0.text: But Conte, this shouldn't be a situation to celebrate. What is your duty?
say:8:1710659007:0.source_cn: 不过，康特。这并非一个值得赞颂的局面。你们的职责是什么？

say:9:1710659008:1.text: Is it to depend on one exceptional archer, or to use your own swords, your discipline, and teamwork to protect the empire?
say:9:1710659008:1.source_cn: 是依赖某一个人的箭术，还是用你们自己的剑，用你们的纪律...

say:10:1710659009:1.text: If your response depends on a sharpshooter falling from the sky, can this unit truly bear the title "Royal Guard"?
say:10:1710659009:1.source_cn: 如果你们的反应，必须等待一个从天而降的神射手来弥补，那...

say:12:1710659011:1.text: See that security is doubled. The hunting grounds, the palace, the Hall of Ancients perimeter. I will not tolerate another lapse.
say:12:1710659011:1.source_cn: 传令下去，加强猎场、王宫等重要区域的戒备，特别是圣古堂...
